text:
ravi: Heads-up — oncall wants a single "cache health" dashboard covering both KV and prefix caches before next rollout. Need clear metrics + alert thresholds. Who can own metric names and ingestion?

tara: I can sketch the dashboard layout. Need the exact metric names and labels from runtime/infra. Also want per-workload and per-tenant breakdowns.

morgan: Runtime can emit labels: model, tenant_id, workload_type (inference|embedding), seq_len_bucket. We're missing a sane eviction_reason label — I can add that.

luis: Infra will handle ingestion and retention. FYI we need to avoid cardinality explosion — suggest sampling tenant_id for heatmap but full tenant metrics only for important tenants (reserved flag).

jen: From product: oncall cares about degradations that affect tail latency + cost spikes. Useful panels: overall hit rate, 95/99 hit-rate drop, eviction bursts, reuse by workload (percent of requests benefiting from prefix reuse).

ravi: Agreed. Proposed metric set (draft):
- redwood_kvcache_ops_total (labels: result=hit|miss|evict, cache=kv|prefix, model, tenant_id, workload_type)
- redwood_kvcache_bytes_cached (gauge)
- redwood_kvcache_evictions_total (labels: reason=memory_pressure|ttl|manual)
- redwood_prefix_reuse_ratio (gauge per-route)
- redwood_kvcache_warm_time_seconds (histogram)

morgan: Example PromQL for eviction rate (we'll expose these in Grafana):
```
rate(redwood_kvcache_evictions_total{cache="kv"}[5m])
```
Hit rate (percent):
```
100 * (rate(redwood_kvcache_ops_total{result="hit"}[5m]) / rate(redwood_kvcache_ops_total[5m]))
```

luis: For per-tenant SLOs we'll need aggregated labels. We can add tenant_tier=reserved|standard to reduce cardinality. Also plan to roll up high-cardinality labels to a separate per-tenant index.

sam: From oncall perspective — alerts we care about: sustained hit rate drop (>15% relative vs baseline for 10m), eviction spike > 200 evictions/min per node, and prefix reuse drop > 30% inside a region. Also an alert for sudden increase in kvcache_warm_time p95.

ravi: Let's record concrete thresholds for the runbook. Draft:
- Alert A: kvcache_hit_rate_drop_15pct — triggers if hit rate drops by 15% vs 1h rolling baseline for 10m.
- Alert B: kvcache_eviction_spike — triggers if rate(redwood_kvcache_evictions_total[2m]) > 200 per node for 5m.
- Alert C: prefix_reuse_regression — triggers if redwood_prefix_reuse_ratio decreases by 30% from rollout baseline for 15m.

jen: Also add a soft-warning channel for product / owners when reuse drops 10% during a canary. It should not page until the 30% threshold.

morgan: Implementation notes: runtime will emit the metrics this week. I'll use a new metrics version v2 with the eviction_reason label. Need infra to add retention and to hook to Grafana.

luis: Infra will create a dashboard folder "Cache Health / Prefix & KV" and a templated dashboard with tenant and model drop-downs. ETA: by EOD Thu. We'll add sample queries and thresholds.

ravi: Runbook steps (initial):
1) Check panel for region/model/tenant.
2) If eviction spike: check node memory, recent deploys, and load shaping rules.
3) If hit-rate drop: run sample queries, compare cold starts, check prefetch logs (link).
4) For prefix reuse regression after deploy: auto-rollback can be considered if reuse drops >50% and tail latency increases.

sam: Please include quick troubleshooting CLI snippets in runbook — e.g., how to query recent misses from logs:
```
# Loki query example
{app="runner",component="kvcache"} |= "MISS" | json | line_format "{model} {tenant} {reason}"
```

ravi: Action items:
- morgan: add eviction_reason label + metrics emit (owner) — deadline: Tue EOD.
- luis: ingest metrics, create Grafana folder and templated dashboard — deadline: Thu EOD.
- tara: initial panel layout + runbook skeleton — deadline: Fri noon.
- jen: define product soft-warning thresholds and who to notify — deadline: Wed.
- sam: review runbook & alert thresholds once draft is up — ongoing.

deploy-bot: New metrics version v2 will be registered in the metrics registry when runtime ships.

morgan: I'll post a PR with the metric names + instrumentation snippets once I finish. Will tag infra for any label concerns.

luis: One more note — for privacy/regulatory tenants, we should expose aggregated metrics only. We'll add a reserved_tenant label and an opt-in full-metrics flag.

ravi: Thanks — let's reconvene Thurs standup to confirm dashboard + alerts are wired. If anyone hits blockers ping @oncall-escalation. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
